messages:
omar (Finance Ops): Heads up - GCP Marketplace invoice GM-2026-1120 has a weird line: reseller consolidated usage appears doubled for reseller partner CloudSpan. Our internal usage shows 18,450 units; invoice lists 36,900. Can someone sanity-check before we raise with partner?
jen (Billing): ugh. Do we have their raw export? I can try to diff if provided.
omar (Finance Ops): Uploaded to /finance/marketplace/inbound/GM-2026-1120-raw.csv. snippet: 
```
partner_account,customer_id,usage_units,plan
cloudspan-parent,cs-001,36900,standard
cloudspan-uk,cs-uk-01,18450,standard
```
jen (Billing): that looks like they sent both parent rollup and child lines. Our ingest rules should collapse duplicates but apparently the parent row slipped through.
rupert (Partner Eng): marketplace-bot, did ingestion drop any rows or flag duplicates for GM-2026-1120?
marketplace-bot: GM-2026-1120 processed 2026-05-11T16:04Z. Alerts: 1 potential parent-child overlap detected for partner cloudspan. Ingestion action: ACCEPTED; dedupe PASS but rollup rows preserved due to non-standard account_type tag.
sophia (RevOps): If the partner intentionally sent both, we need partner confirmation. Financial impact = invoice overstatement of ~ $9.2k (estimated at list rates). That exceeds approval threshold.
jen (Billing): For interim safety, recommend blocking settlement for that partner until we confirm. Also prepare GL reversing entry if we already booked revenue.
omar (Finance Ops): We haven't closed month-end yet, booking in pending clearing. I'll hold posting. Can someone draft a short ticket to CloudSpan asking which row to use and request corrected CSV + credit note if it's an overcharge?
rupert (Partner Eng): I'll open convo now. Suggested message: "We observed both parent rollup and child lines in GM-2026-1120 leading to duplicated units for UK accounts. Please confirm intended billing granularity and provide amended export or credit note." OK?
sophia (RevOps): LGTM. @jen when we get partner confirmation, please attach amended CSV to /finance/marketplace/corrections/GM-2026-1120-amended.csv and cc me for revenue adjustments.
jen (Billing): Will do. Also flag: if partner says it was intentional (they billed parent+child for different entitlements), we need signed proof or contract clause.
omar (Finance Ops): noted. rupert - any ETA from rep?
rupert (Partner Eng): pinged rep at 16:12 PT. Replied: "looking into it, suspect export script included both rollup and detail rows; asking GCP PM to regenerate." ETA 24-48h.
sophia (RevOps): ok. tagging this thread for follow-up. If no response in 48h we'll escalate to partner ops.
jen (Billing): adding checklist: 1) hold settlement; 2) await amended CSV; 3) if amended shows overcharge prepare credit memo + GL 5021; 4) escalate if no partner response in 48h.
omar (Finance Ops): thanks all. I'll update when file landed. Marking as open until amended CSV attached. :white_check_mark:
